analysis.summaryJa: このページは、感情を引き起こす物・出来事を-ing形で、感情を受け取った人を-ed形で表す対比と、過去分詞が完了した出来事の結果・状態を形容詞として表す働きを扱う。職場の説明会、顧客対応、配送、設備、研修などの場面で、原因と経験者、進行中の動きと完了後の状態を区別できるように40問へ展開した。
grammarPoints: 感情を起こす物・出来事にはinteresting、confusing、encouragingなどの-ing形を用いる
感情を経験する人にはinterested、confused、encouragedなどの-ed形を用いる
fallen、retired、damaged、completedなどの過去分詞が完了後の結果・状態を表す
look・feel・sound・seemなどの後ろで-ed形を述語形容詞として使う
原因を主語にする文と経験者を主語にする受動的な文を意味を保って言い換える
visualEvidence: 画面から視聴者へ火花が飛ぶ矢印が、-ingの原因から-edの経験者へ感情が届く関係を示している
「thing/event + -ing」と「person + -ed」の対向ブロックが原因と受け手を明確に分けている
落ち葉と引退した人物の図が、fallen・retiredが完了した出来事の結果状態を表すことを示している
感情を観察する実験室の構図が、何が感情を起こし誰がそれを受けたかを問う視点を強調している
commonTraps: 人を主語にしながら感情の原因を表す-ing形を選ぶ
物・出来事を主語にしながら経験者を表す-ed形を選ぶ
fallingとfallen、retiringとretiredのように進行中と完了結果を混同する
look・feelの後ろで形容詞ではなく副詞を選ぶ
原因文と経験者文の言い換えで主語・目的語の関係を逆にする

questions.prompt: The safety video was ------- enough to hold every employee’s attention.

choices.B: engage
choices.C: engaging
choices.D: engagement

questions.translationJa: その安全教育動画は、全従業員の注意を引きつけるほど魅力的でした。
questions.explanationJa: 注意を引きつける原因はvideoなので、感情・反応を起こす側を表す-ing形engagingが必要です。

questions.prompt: Several visitors were ------- by the last-minute change of venue.

choices.B: confusing
choices.C: confusion
choices.D: confuse

questions.translationJa: 数名の来訪者は、直前の会場変更に戸惑いました。
questions.explanationJa: 戸惑いを感じた側はvisitorsなので、経験者を表す-ed形confusedが正解です。

questions.prompt: The client found the product demonstration ------- because the examples were practical.

choices.B: reassure
choices.C: reassurance
choices.D: reassuring

questions.translationJa: 顧客は、例が実用的だったため、その製品実演に安心感を覚えました。
questions.explanationJa: demonstrationが顧客を安心させる原因なので、目的語補語にはreassuringを置きます。

questions.prompt: The ceremony honored a ------- engineer who designed the original factory.

choices.B: retired
choices.C: retire
choices.D: retirement

questions.translationJa: 式典では、元の工場を設計した引退済みの技師を表彰しました。
questions.explanationJa: すでに引退した結果状態を表すため、過去分詞形容詞retiredが適切です。

questions.prompt: The ------- customer asked for a written explanation of the additional fee.

choices.B: disappointing
choices.C: disappoint
choices.D: disappointment

questions.translationJa: 失望した顧客は、追加料金について書面での説明を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: 失望を感じているのはcustomerなので-ed形disappointedを使います。

questions.prompt: The quarterly results were ------- to everyone who had expected a loss.

choices.B: surprise
choices.C: surprising
choices.D: surprisingly

questions.translationJa: 四半期業績は、赤字を予想していた全員にとって驚くべきものでした。
questions.explanationJa: resultsが驚きを起こす原因なので、-ing形surprisingが必要です。

questions.prompt: The maintenance team removed the ------- sign from above the entrance.

choices.B: damaged
choices.C: damage
choices.D: damages

questions.translationJa: 保守チームは入口上部の損傷した看板を撤去しました。
questions.explanationJa: 看板は損傷を受けた後の状態にあるため、結果を表す過去分詞damagedが正解です。
questions.focus: 受動・結果状態の過去分詞

questions.prompt: The trainees looked ------- after the three-hour emergency drill.

choices.B: exhaust
choices.C: exhaustion
choices.D: exhausted

questions.translationJa: 研修生たちは3時間の緊急訓練後、疲れ切っているように見えました。
questions.explanationJa: lookの後ろでtraineesの感じた状態を説明する-ed形exhaustedを使います。

questions.prompt: The updated instructions are less ------- than the previous version.

choices.B: confusion
choices.C: confusing
choices.D: confuse

questions.translationJa: 更新された説明書は、前の版ほど分かりにくくありません。
questions.explanationJa: instructionsが利用者を混乱させる性質を表すため、原因側のconfusingが正解です。

questions.prompt: The grounds crew cleared the ------- branches after the overnight storm.

choices.B: falling
choices.C: fell
choices.D: fall

questions.translationJa: 構内整備員は夜間の嵐の後、落ちた枝を片づけました。
questions.explanationJa: すでに落下が完了した枝なので、結果状態を表すfallenを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an orientation session.

choices.A: The orientation was informed, and the new hires were interesting throughout.
choices.B: The orientation was informative, and the new hires were interested throughout.
choices.C: The orientation was informatively, and the new hires were interest throughout.
choices.D: The orientation interested, and the new hires were interesting throughout.

questions.translationJa: そのオリエンテーションは有益で、新入社員は終始関心を持っていました。
questions.explanationJa: sessionの性質はinformative、人の感情はinterestedで表すため、この組み合わせだけが自然です。
questions.focus: 物の性質と人の感情の区別

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a customer’s reaction to a delay.

choices.A: The delaying shipment left the customer frustrating.
choices.B: The shipment delayed left the customer frustration.
choices.C: The delayed shipment left the customer frustratingly.
choices.D: The delayed shipment left the customer frustrated.

questions.translationJa: 遅延した配送品のため、顧客はいら立ちました。
questions.explanationJa: shipmentは遅延を受けたのでdelayed、customerは感情を経験したのでfrustratedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an engineer who no longer works for the company.

choices.A: The retired engineer attended the company’s anniversary dinner.
choices.B: The retiring engineer attended the dinner after leaving the company years ago.
choices.C: The retirement engineer attended the company’s anniversary dinner.
choices.D: The engineer retiredly attended the company’s anniversary dinner.

questions.translationJa: 引退した技師が会社の周年記念夕食会に出席しました。
questions.explanationJa: すでに職を退いた人の状態はretiredで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence connecting an announcement with the staff’s response.

choices.A: The announcement was encouraged, so the staff felt encouraging.
choices.B: The announcement encouraging, so the staff were encouragement.
choices.C: The announcement was encouraging, so the staff felt encouraged.
choices.D: The announcement was encouragingly, so the staff felt encourage.

questions.translationJa: その発表は励みになる内容だったので、社員は勇気づけられました。
questions.explanationJa: 発表は感情を起こす側なのでencouraging、社員は受ける側なのでencouragedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a display panel already lying on the floor.

choices.A: The falling display panel was removed after it had been on the floor all night.
choices.B: The fell display panel was removed from the lobby.
choices.C: The display panel fallingly was removed from the lobby.
choices.D: The fallen display panel was removed from the lobby.

questions.translationJa: 落下した展示パネルはロビーから撤去されました。
questions.explanationJa: 落下が完了した状態なのでfallenを使います。fallingなら落下中という意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a customer after a refund was approved.

choices.A: The customer sounded relieving after receiving the refund.
choices.B: The customer sounded relieved after receiving the refund.
choices.C: The customer sounded relief after receiving the refund.
choices.D: The customer relievedly sounded after receiving the refund.

questions.translationJa: 返金を受けた後、その顧客は安心した様子でした。
questions.explanationJa: soundは連結動詞で、顧客の感じた状態を形容詞relievedが説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about repeated system errors.

choices.A: The support team was worrying by the repeated system errors.
choices.B: The worried system errors concerned the support team worrying.
choices.C: The support team was worried by the repeated system errors.
choices.D: The support team was worryingly by the repeated system errors.

questions.translationJa: サポートチームは繰り返すシステムエラーを心配していました。
questions.explanationJa: 心配を感じたのはsupport teamなのでworriedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a survey whose collection period has ended.

choices.A: The completed survey contains responses from eight hundred guests.
choices.B: The completing survey contains responses after collection ended.
choices.C: The completion survey contains responses from eight hundred guests.
choices.D: The survey completedly contains responses from eight hundred guests.

questions.translationJa: 完了した調査には800人の宿泊客からの回答が含まれています。
questions.explanationJa: 調査が完了した結果状態を表す過去分詞completedがsurveyを修飾します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting a film and its audience.

choices.A: The documentary was fascinated, but the audience was tiring.
choices.B: The documentary fascinatingly, but the audience tired.
choices.C: The fascinated documentary made the audience tiring.
choices.D: The documentary was fascinating, but the audience was tired.

questions.translationJa: そのドキュメンタリーは魅力的でしたが、観客は疲れていました。
questions.explanationJa: 作品が興味を起こすのでfascinating、人の状態はtiredで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an employee reacting to an award.

choices.A: Ms. Park looked surprising when her project won the award.
choices.B: Ms. Park looked surprised when her project won the award.
choices.C: Ms. Park looked surprise when her project won the award.
choices.D: Ms. Park surprisingly looked when her project won the award.

questions.translationJa: パークさんは自分のプロジェクトが受賞したとき、驚いた様子でした。
questions.explanationJa: 驚きを感じた人をlookの後ろで説明するためsurprisedを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The revised schedule confused several participants."

choices.A: Several participants revised the confusing schedule.
choices.B: The schedule was confused about several participants.
choices.C: Several participants made the schedule less confusing.
choices.D: Several participants were confused by the revised schedule.

questions.translationJa: 数名の参加者は改訂日程に困惑しました。
questions.explanationJa: 原因を主語にしたconfusedの能動文を、経験者を主語にしてbe confused byで言い換えています。
questions.focus: 原因文と経験者文の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The client was satisfied with the repair."

choices.A: The client repaired the item without assistance.
choices.B: The repair met the client’s expectations.
choices.C: The repair made the client more demanding.
choices.D: The client was still waiting for the repair.

questions.translationJa: その修理は顧客の期待を満たしました。
questions.explanationJa: be satisfied withは「満足している」で、期待を満たしたという文が同じ結果を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The seminar was inspiring to the design team."

choices.A: The design team gave the seminar without preparation.
choices.B: The seminar was inspired by a design team’s complaint.
choices.C: The design team felt inspired by the seminar.
choices.D: The design team found the seminar unnecessary.

questions.translationJa: デザインチームはそのセミナーに刺激を受けました。
questions.explanationJa: seminarが原因、design teamが経験者という関係を-inspired byで保っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The bridge is closed because the storm damaged it."

choices.B: The bridge is damaging the storm and must close.
choices.C: The closed storm is damaging the bridge.
choices.D: The bridge remained open during the storm.

questions.translationJa: 嵐で損傷した橋は通行止めです。
questions.explanationJa: damageを受けた結果状態を複合的な過去分詞修飾storm-damagedで簡潔に表しています。
questions.focus: 過去分詞による結果の圧縮

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The manager who has retired will be honored at lunch."

choices.B: The retiring lunch manager will honor the staff.
choices.C: The retired manager will be honored at lunch.
choices.D: The manager honored retirement by canceling lunch.

questions.focus: 完了節からretiredへの言い換え

choices.A: Our regular customers increased the price themselves.
choices.B: The price increase was worried about our customers.
choices.C: Our regular customers were pleased with the lower price.
choices.D: Our regular customers were worried about the price increase.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The instructions were puzzling to the interns."

choices.A: The interns were puzzled by the instructions.
choices.B: The interns wrote the instructions as a puzzle.
choices.C: The instructions were solved before the interns arrived.
choices.D: The interns found the instructions perfectly clear.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The signed contract is in the top drawer."

choices.A: The contract must be signed inside the top drawer.
choices.B: The contract that has been signed is in the top drawer.
choices.C: The top drawer contains a contract that has not been approved.
choices.D: The contract signs the top drawer automatically.

questions.translationJa: 署名済みの契約書は一番上の引き出しにあります。
questions.explanationJa: signedという結果状態をthat has been signedという完了受動節で展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The audience found the product launch exciting."

choices.A: The product launch excited the audience.
choices.B: The audience launched an exciting product.
choices.C: The product launch was excited about the audience.
choices.D: The audience left before the product launch began.

questions.translationJa: 製品発表会は観客をわくわくさせました。
questions.explanationJa: find＋物＋excitingで示す原因の働きを、動詞excitedで直接表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The inspectors were alarmed by the smoke."

choices.A: The inspectors installed a smoke alarm.
choices.B: The smoke was removed before the inspectors arrived.
choices.C: The smoke was alarming to the inspectors.
choices.D: The inspectors alarmed the smoke detector.

questions.translationJa: その煙は検査員を不安にさせるものでした。
questions.explanationJa: inspectorsが感情を受けた-ed文を、smokeを原因にする-ing文へ言い換えています。

questions.prompt: The keynote speaker used vivid examples and answered every question. Most attendees described the session as -------.

choices.B: fascinated
choices.C: fascination
choices.D: fascinate

questions.translationJa: 基調講演者は鮮明な例を使い、すべての質問に答えました。多くの参加者はその講演を非常に魅力的だと評しました。
questions.explanationJa: sessionが参加者の関心を引き起こす側なのでfascinatingが適切です。

choices.C: relieved
choices.D: relieve

choices.B: disappointment

choices.D: disappointed

questions.prompt: Sales exceeded the target for a third consecutive month. These are ------- results for the entire branch.

choices.B: encouraging
choices.C: encouragement
choices.D: encourage

questions.prompt: The chief executive entered the break room without prior notice. Several employees looked -------.

questions.prompt: The trainer demonstrated three shortcuts that no one on the team had seen before. The demonstration was especially -------.

choices.B: interest

questions.explanationJa: demonstrationが関心を起こす側なのでinterestingが正解です。

questions.prompt: A small leak was discovered near the electrical cabinet. Facilities staff are ------- about possible damage.

questions.explanationJa: 心配を感じる人staffには-ed形concernedを用います。

questions.prompt: The warehouse closed five years ago and has remained unused since then. The ------- building will be converted into offices.

choices.B: abandonment

choices.D: abandoned

questions.translationJa: その倉庫は5年前に閉鎖され、それ以来使われていません。放棄された建物はオフィスへ改装されます。
questions.explanationJa: 建物が放棄された後の状態を過去分詞abandonedが表します。
